weekend_note: Cold and dry this weekend: frost is possible early Saturday, with a high only near 59, then a mild rebound to the mid 60s Sunday. Rain chances return around Monday and Tuesday (about 20%). Picks are mostly outdoors, so bundle up: Festa Italiana (last day), the Fall Food Truck Fest, Bands on the Bayou and EggFest. For indoors, try the Ice Flyers' Blue Angels Night at the Bay Center Saturday or the Symphony's Music for Families. Sunday's SEC women's soccer final is outdoors too. Isaias recovery still affects some places, so double-check before heading out.

news.title: Coldest air of the season arrives Friday night, frost possible Saturday
news.summary: Lows should reach the 30s across the region early Saturday, with highs only in the upper 50s. Temperatures warm gradually from Sunday.

news.title: Waterfront Rescue Mission opens cold weather shelter Friday and Saturday
news.summary: The shelter at 348 W. Herman Ave. serves men and women without children and will work with partners for women with kids. Hours were not listed.

news.title: SS United States sank upright off Destin after a valve delay
news.summary: The ship went down Nov 11 and rests upright around 180 feet deep about 22 miles offshore. Divers hoped to reach it as soon as Friday.

news.title: Pensacola leaders weigh phased repairs for former Gibson School
news.summary: Repairs top $6.2M. A first phase of about $2.8M would weatherproof the building; council could pick an option or defer.

news.title: SEC keeps women's soccer championship in Pensacola two more years
news.summary: The conference extended its contract with Pensacola Sports and Escambia County. Last year's event brought about $2.6M in local revenue.

news.title: Pensacola Beach Gulf Pier reopens after Isaias closure
news.summary: The roughly 1,470-foot pier reopened at 6 AM Friday after several weeks closed, another step in the beach's recovery.

news.title: Santa Rosa County puts Isaias cleanup near $80M
news.summary: Federal and state reimbursement should cover most of it, leaving the county about $10M.

news.title: Manna Food Pantries sees lasting surge in need after Isaias
news.summary: The pantry network reports demand from Northwest Florida families has stayed high since the storm.

coverage_note: Updated Saturday, Nov 14. Weather: Saturday and Sunday come from WEAR (Sunday low and all days from Monday on from WeatherBug's Nov 13 forecast); rain chance was only given for Mon and Tue, so other days show 0% and may be off. Sources disagree somewhat on lows. Events come from Must Do Pensacola's weekend guide, Local Pulse's weekend top 10 and Must Do's November guide; Visit Pensacola and Downtown Pensacola listings would not load, so December items are carried over and 'See event page' marks missing times. North Escambia (Gonzalez, Molino, Beulah, Cantonment) coverage is thin: NorthEscambia.com searches returned only 2025 items, so no new events were added there and the Cantonment Harvest Festival was dropped as past. Restaurant statuses were mostly carried over; Must Do's November openings article was re-read. Monday's rain chance (20%) comes from WeatherBug; an earlier run had 40%, so treat it as uncertain.
